content.title: Paylocity’s (NASDAQ:PCTY) Q3: Beats On Revenue
content.summary: HR and payroll software provider Paylocity (NASDAQ:PCTY) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 12.5% year on year to $408.2 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $408 million, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.75 per share was 11.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
